dialog.title: Connect WhatsApp
dialog.instructions:
Enter the E.164 phone number that should receive platform WhatsApp messages (digits with country code, optional leading +).

The recipient must have opted in to messages from your WhatsApp Business number. Free-form text only works inside the 24-hour customer service window.
